info.title: Open API Async
info.description:
## 📘 Async API Documentation

This documentation includes **two types of APIs based on authentication mechanism and access scope**.

Both types can be used for integrations depending on the use case.

---

### 🏪 Seller Manager Access (JWT Authentication)

- 🔐 **Authentication Type:** JWT Token
- 🔑 **Token Generation API:** `/async/v2/tokens/generate`
- 📌 **Usage:** Does **not require `customer_code` in the path**
- 📍 **Scope:** Operates within the context of the authenticated company

Example:
```
/async/v2/b2c/orders
/async/v2/b2b/orders
/async/v2/products
/async/v2/products/modify_image
/async/v2/suppliers
/async/v2/suppliers/update_supplier
/async/v2/buyers
/async/v2/buyers/update_buyer
/async/v2/consignments
/async/v2/consignments/update_consignment
```

---

### 🔐 OAuth Access (Customer Scope)

- 🔐 **Authentication Type:** OAuth Access Token
- 🔑 **Token Generation API:** `/oauth/token`
- 📌 **Usage:** Requires `customer_code` in the API path
- 📍 **Scope:** Operates on behalf of the specified customer
- ⚠️ **Note:** For customer-scoped APIs, `customer_code` is mandatory

Example:
```
/async/v2/customers/{customer_code}/b2c_orders
/async/v2/customers/{customer_code}/b2b_orders
/async/v2/customers/{customer_code}/products
/async/v2/customers/{customer_code}/products/modify_image
/async/v2/customers/{customer_code}/suppliers
/async/v2/customers/{customer_code}/suppliers/update_supplier
/async/v2/customers/{customer_code}/buyers
/async/v2/customers/{customer_code}/buyers/update_buyer
/async/v2/customers/{customer_code}/consignments
/async/v2/customers/{customer_code}/consignments/update_consignment
```

---

### ⚡ Async API Behavior

- APIs accept **bulk requests** (multiple records in a single request)
- A **`request_id`** is returned immediately upon acceptance
- Processing happens asynchronously in the background
- Final results are delivered via **callback/webhook mechanism**
- Each item in the request is processed independently (partial success possible)

---

### ❗ Validation Errors (Common Across All Async APIs)

These validations happen **before request is accepted**:

#### 1. Invalid Content-Type
```json
{ "error": "Invalid Content-Type. Expected 'application/json'." }
```

#### 2. Invalid JSON
```json
{ "error": "Invalid JSON format." }
```

#### 3. Request Size Exceeded
```json
{ "error": "Request size exceeds the limit of 500000 bytes." }
```

#### 4. Invalid Bulk Structure
```json
{ "error": "Invalid bulk request. 'data' must be a non-empty array." }
```

#### 5. Max Limit Exceeded
```json
{ "error": "Maximum 50 items are allowed per request." }
```

---

### ⚠️ Important Notes

- Ensure the correct authentication method is used for the respective API
- For customer-scoped APIs, `customer_code` is mandatory
- Maximum **50 records per request** are allowed
- Duplicate identifiers in a request may be ignored after the first occurrence
- Callback responses may arrive **out of order**
- The response details for each item will include additional integration-specific information and will be available **only for successful records**

post.description:
This API allows bulk creation of B2C Orders asynchronously.

---
### High-Level Request Structure
```json
{
  "data": [
    { "b2c_order": { ... } },
    { "b2c_order": { ... } }
  ]
}
```

---
### Behavior
- Max **50 records per request**
- Returns **request_id immediately**
- Processing happens asynchronously
- Final response sent via **callback API**

---
### Important Notes
- Same payload as V1, just wrapped inside `data[]`
- Each item processed independently
- Partial success possible

---
### Callback Payload (What your system will receive)

Once processing is complete, the result will be sent to the configured callback URL.

```json
{
  "request_id": "1a5b68a345f957f5e02ff083ff3ccb16",
  "api_path": "/b2c/orders",
  "results": [
    {
      "number": "ASYNC-BULK-0001",
      "status": "success",
      "details": {
        "response": "success",
        "message": "Order successfully created",
        "order_number": "ASYNC-BULK-0001",
        "data": [],
        "state": "draft",
        "id": 10584
      }
    },
    {
      "number": "ASYNC-BULK-0002",
      "status": "failure",
      "error": "Number has already been taken"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### Notes:
- Each record is processed independently
- `details` is present only for success
- `error` is present only for failure
- Partial success is possible

buyer_code.description: Buyer code. When provided, buyer's address is used as billing and shipping address if those are not supplied. Optional.

Use this API to generate an OAuth2 access token. Copy & Paste the JSON below in the Request Body: 
        {
          \"grant_type\": \"password\",
          \"client_id\": \"YOUR_CLIENT_ID\",
          \"client_secret\": \"YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET\",
          \"username\": \"user@example.com\",
          \"password\": \"your_password\",
          \"scope\": \"store customer\"
        }

client_id.description: The unique identifier for the client application [REQUIRED]

client_secret.description: The secret key associated with the client application [REQUIRED]

username.description: Email of seller admin at WMS (Required for password grant) [CONDITIONAL]

password.description: Password of seller admin at WMS (Required for password grant) [CONDITIONAL]

refresh_token.description: Token to obtain a new access token (Required for refresh_token grant) [CONDITIONAL]

access_token.description: Token to be used for authentication

expires_in.description: The number of seconds until the access token expires

refresh_token.description: A token used to obtain a new access token once the current one expires

scope.description: Specifies the level of access granted

created_at.description: The Unix timestamp indicating when the token was created

error.description: The error code indicating the issue; Eg: unsupported_grant_type

error_description.description: A detailed message explaining the error

post.description:
This API allows bulk creation of B2C Orders asynchronously **for a specific customer**.

---
### High-Level Request Structure
```json
{
  "data": [
    { "b2c_order": { ... } },
    { "b2c_order": { ... } }
  ]
}
```

---
### Authentication
- Uses **Doorkeeper access token**
- Requires `customer_code` in path

---
### Behavior
- Max **50 records per request**
- Returns **request_id immediately**
- Async processing via background jobs
- Final response via callback

---
### Important Notes
- Same payload as Seller API
- Customer context derived from `customer_code`

---
### Callback Payload (What your system will receive)

Once processing is complete, the result will be sent to the configured callback URL.

```json
{
  "request_id": "1a5b68a345f957f5e02ff083ff3ccb16",
  "api_path": "/customers/{customer_code}/b2c_orders",
  "results": [
    {
      "number": "ASYNC-BULK-0001",
      "status": "success",
      "details": {
        "response": "success",
        "message": "Order successfully created",
        "order_number": "ASYNC-BULK-0001",
        "data": [],
        "state": "draft",
        "id": 10584
      }
    },
    {
      "number": "ASYNC-BULK-0002",
      "status": "failure",
      "error": "Number has already been taken"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### Notes:
- Each record is processed independently
- `details` is present only for success
- `error` is present only for failure
- Partial success is possible

post.summary: Bulk Create B2B Orders (Async - Customer Scope)
post.description:
This API allows bulk creation of B2B Orders asynchronously **for a specific customer**.

---
### High-Level Request Structure
```json
{
  "data": [
    { "b2b_order": { ... } },
    { "b2b_order": { ... } }
  ]
}
```

---
### Authentication
- Uses **Doorkeeper access token**
- Requires `customer_code` in path

---
### Behavior
- Max **50 records per request**
- Returns **request_id immediately**
- Async processing via background jobs
- Final response via callback

---
### Important Notes
- Same payload as Seller API
- Customer context derived from `customer_code`

---
### Callback Payload (What your system will receive)

Once processing is complete, the result will be sent to the configured callback URL.

```json
{
  "request_id": "1a5b68a345f957f5e02ff083ff3ccb16",
  "api_path": "/customers/{customer_code}/b2b_orders",
  "results": [
    {
      "number": "ASYNC-BULK-0001",
      "status": "success",
      "details": {
        "response": "success",
        "message": "Order created",
        "order_number": "ASYNC-BULK-0001",
        "data": [],
        "state": "draft",
        "id": 10584
      }
    },
    {
      "number": "ASYNC-BULK-0002",
      "status": "failure",
      "error": "Number has already been taken"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### Notes:
- Each record is processed independently
- `details` is present only for success
- `error` is present only for failure
- Partial success is possible

post.description:
## Async Callback (Webhook)

This endpoint represents the **callback payload structure** that will be sent once async processing is completed.

**Note:**
- This is **not an API you call**
- This is the **payload your system should be able to receive**
- The callback URL must be configured in the system

---

### Behavior

- Triggered after async processing completes
- Sent per request using `request_id`
- Contains results for all submitted records
- Supports **partial success and failure**

---

### Payload Structure

```json
{
  "request_id": "string",
  "api_path": "string",
  "results": [ ... ]
}
```

---

### Field Details

- `request_id` → Unique identifier returned during async request
- `api_path` → API endpoint which was called
- `results` → Array of per-item processing results

---

### Result Object Variants

#### Success
```json
{
  "number": "ORDER123",
  "status": "success",
  "details": {
    "response": "success",
    "message": "Order created",
    "id": 12345
  }
}
```

#### Failure
```json
{
  "number": "ORDER123",
  "status": "failure",
  "error": "Validation failed"
}
```

---

### Important Notes

- Each item is processed independently
- `details` is present **only on success**
- `error` is present **only on failure**
- Response order is **not guaranteed**
- Callback retried up to **3 times** on failure

results.description: Each item represents success or failure result
